verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM claims 'no frustrating setup required', and hands-on users report getting running in minutes. One user says Ollama was detected automatically, manual setup was still available, and adding Hugging Face was painless, which points to in-app model configuration rather than editing config files. None of the evidence actually describes a step-by-step first-run wizard or what it covers. Missing for 10: documented first-run wizard flow, explicit credential/API-key entry step, channel setup, defaults configuration step.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files

citations.quote: hyper-configurable, multi-user, & no frustrating setup required
With Ollama, everything was automatically detected, while manual setup is still possible.
this has been the only offline AI tool I've been able to install and start using on my standard office PC
